name: Cité de la musique
description: group of buildings dedicated to music in the Parc de la Villette, Paris, France

summary.text: The Cité de la Musique, also known as Philharmonie 2, is a group of institutions dedicated to music and situated in the Parc de la Villette, 19th arrondissement of Paris, France.
